title: A rule's mechanism row lists every guard that holds part of it
why: lint/rule_mechanisms.json maps rule shared-trees-archive-then-delete to guard shared-tree only, and a row takes one ref, so the new archive-then-delete guard from #1796 has no row (coordinator, 23:49 CST Nov 7).
note: Held under the item 384 hold. Two forms: a row lists every guard that holds part of the rule, or the row names the new archive-then-delete guard. No departure from a ruling, so no page item (coordinator). Title from the coordinator's message. Filed 23:51 CST Nov 7.
